sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
Please refer to the following document named "SWSLHD_5504 - Part B - Specifications"
The objectives of Transitional Aged Care Program (TACP) are to:
• Support older people or maintain functional independence
• Support achievement of person-centered rehabilitation goals
• Facilitate safe discharge from hospital to home
• Reduce avoidable hospital readmissions
• Delay or prevent premature admissions to residential aged care• Support transition to longer-term community support where required
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Please refer to the following document named "SWSLHD_5504 - Part B - Specifications"
The successful provider(s) must be capable of delivering the following:
a) Home Care Services, including:
• Personal Care
• Showering Assistance
• Assistance with activities of daily living
• Domestic assistance• Household cleaning• Light errands
• Transport to appointments
• Community access support
• Meal Preperation
• Welfare and wellbeing checks
• Support aligned with approved TACP care plans
b) Community Nursing Services
c) Podiatry ServicesExcluded Services
The following services are excluded from this procurement:
• Acute hospital services
• Residential aged care services
• Long-term aged care services
• Equipment supply and rehabilitation aids
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:

Tenderers are to register their attendance to Webnair by using the link Register Here.
